propositions: Add a new commit_and_push_tickets_branch function that acquires a write lock, checks for rebase/merge-recovery state, stages and commits dirty tracker changes with optional supplied git identity, then delegates to push_tickets_branch.
Strict mode raises PushDeliveryError when a rebase/merge-recovery is detected before committing; default mode logs a warning and returns without staging or pushing, preserving content for retry.
Supplied author_name and author_email are applied per-commit via git -c flags without mutating global or repository config; ambient identity is used when omitted.

Clean but locally-ahead trackers are pushed without creating empty commits; persistent rejection under strict mode preserves the local commit and raises PushDeliveryError rather than reporting success.

Lock, staging, and commit failures raise PushDeliveryError with stable reasons (commit-lock-timeout, stage-failed, commit-failed); strict mode raises, default mode warns and returns without invoking push.
The new commit-and-push CLI action is added to the private adapter alongside the existing push-only action, sharing one PushDeliveryError translation boundary.
